principles.title: Evidence over adjectives
principles.text: We show architecture, trade-offs and limitations. No invented metrics, testimonials or client logos. What you read is what we can point to.

principles.title: Accessible by default
principles.text: Semantic HTML, 44px targets, keyboard paths that work, focus that you can see. We test at 200% zoom, not just on our MacBooks.

principles.title: Secure boundaries
principles.text: Data is partitioned by role, tokens stay short-lived, and we keep secrets out of the client. Security is a constraint, not a badge.

principles.title: Tests for critical paths
principles.text: Auth, payments (when real), ingestion and scoring have tests. We don't chase coverage theatre; we protect the paths that hurt if broken.

principles.title: Honest AI labels
principles.text: Rules are called rules. RAG is RAG. We never label a heuristic a 'trained model' and we cite sources or say we couldn't find one.

principles.title: Clear ownership
principles.text: Every project has a named lead. Questions have somewhere to go, decisions have an owner, and blame has no home.

operatingSystem.d: Define the real problem and its non-goals.
Make the smallest thing that can fail usefully.
Break it, measure it, bring dissent.
Edit until only the essential remains.
